text: 创业板指跌超2%，沪指跌0.64%，深成指跌1.62%，AI应用、算力租赁、医药医疗、软件开发等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4200只
text_en: ChiNext Index falls over 2%, Shanghai Composite drops 0.64%, Shenzhen Component declines 1.62%; AI applications, computing power leasing, pharmaceutical and healthcare, and software development lead losses; nearly 4,200 stocks fall across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
